crossRefs.note: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire?…

translations.web: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’
translations.bsb: All the sinners among My people will die by the sword— all those who say, ‘Disaster will never draw near or confront us.’”
translations.kjv: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent
